scope: Windows product payload: EpoCanva.exe, epocanva_tsf.dll and rime.dll; acceptance profile and distribution policy are separate package metadata
policy_semantics: All listed payload paths are required. Nonempty source rows fix the exact SHA-256 and byte count. Empty source rows identify receipt-bound binaries or generated VERSION.txt. No unlisted package file is admitted except package.manifest itself.

runtime_libraries.name: marisa-trie
runtime_libraries.delivery: static library linked into rime.dll and used by OpenCC

runtime_libraries.name: OpenCC
runtime_libraries.upstream_notice: No NOTICE file in this pinned checkout

runtime_libraries.name: RapidJSON
runtime_libraries.delivery: headers compiled into OpenCC Config.cpp, then linked into rime.dll
runtime_libraries.scope_notes: The full upstream composite licence is retained. JSON-licensed bin/jsonchecker code is absent from the vendored headers and is not built. msinttypes is selected only for _MSC_VER < 1800 (rapidjson.h:162-167), so it is not built by the current VS2022 recipe. Vendored document.h and rapidjson.h differ from the upstream release; their identity is the pinned OpenCC tree, not a claim of byte equality with upstream v1.1.0.

runtime_libraries.name: utfcpp
runtime_libraries.delivery: librime include/utf8.h and include/utf8 headers compiled into rime.dll
runtime_libraries.correction: The actual permission statement is Boost Software License 1.0, including its machine-executable-object-code exception. Historical MIT classification is incorrect.

runtime_libraries.name: darts-clone
runtime_libraries.delivery: librime include/darts.h and OpenCC deps/darts-clone-0.32/darts.h compiled into rime.dll
runtime_libraries.scope_notes: Retain the upstream ORGANIZATION placeholder verbatim. The OpenCC header copy has no separate licence file; the same project's notice is provided by the librime checkout.

runtime_libraries.name: X11 keysym headers
runtime_libraries.delivery: keysym.h includes keysymdef.h; header constants used by rime.dll
runtime_libraries.licence: X11 notices from The Open Group and Digital Equipment Corporation
runtime_libraries.scope_notes: Both complete headers are carried as notice files; keysymdef.h adds the 1994 copyright year. No X11 runtime library is linked.

historical_lock_interpretation.current_identity_fields: packages[].pinned_commit and required declared_submodules[].recorded_commit are checked by tools/build_librime_baseline.ps1
historical_lock_interpretation.historical_fields: P1_*/P2_* artefact_identity values are identities of the historical linked binaries; the lock explicitly says DLL digests are not reproducibility checksums. previous_sha256_superseded is historical by name.
historical_lock_interpretation.adaptation_digest_drift: The P2.5 build_librime_baseline.ps1 SHA-256 in epocanva_build_adaptation_inputs no longer matches the current entry point. This section is old recipe evidence, not a field read by current build assertions. Current source fingerprints and the verified build receipt must bind the current recipe; do not overwrite historical results.
historical_lock_interpretation.data_lock: data/manifests/english-pilot.sources.lock.json still fixes the actual Alt12Dicts source identity and converter input hashes. The product converter creates a separately named product artifact and provenance; the pilot output is not packaged.
